home.title: All your clients in one cozy place
home.lead: A simple, friendly platform for freelancers: keep contacts, take notes and see where every collaboration stands. No clutter, so more time is left for the work that matters.
home.heroAlt: A smiling freelancer working on a laptop by a window with an autumn view
home.eveningAlt: A man working on a laptop, with a client list from the CRM shown next to him
home.aboutText: Freelancing often starts with scattered notes, emails and bookmarks. This platform gathers everything you need to work with clients in one place: who they are, what their company does, what you agreed on and where the collaboration stands. It is a calm workspace with no complicated settings, equally comfortable on a computer and on a phone.

features.title: Clients at hand
features.text: Each client's name, company, email and notes live in a single list, and a client card opens with one click.

features.title: Clear stages
features.text: Every client has a status: lead, active or archived. You can see at a glance who you are working with right now.

features.title: Private access
features.text: The workspace opens once an administrator approves your application, which keeps the platform tidy and secure.

features.title: Your language and theme
features.text: Ukrainian, English, Polish and Czech, a light and a dark theme, and a layout that works well on a phone.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Create an account: all you need is a name, an email and a password.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.text: An administrator reviews your application and opens access to the workspace.

steps.title: Work with clients
steps.text: Once approved, you get the client list and cards with all the details.

home.closingText: Submit your application, it takes a minute. As soon as it is approved, your workspace is ready.

Hello [client name],

Task
[One or two sentences: what needs to be done and why]

- [item 2]
- [item 3]

Timeline

Price

mobileApp.title: App for your phone
mobileApp.lead: You can install FreelanceCRM on your phone like a regular app. It opens without an address bar, has its own icon and works the same as the website.
steps: Download the FreelanceCRM.apk file to your phone and open it: from the download notification or from the Downloads folder.
If Android asks for permission to install from this source, allow it for your browser or file manager. This is needed because the app is not from Google Play.
If Google Play Protect warns about an unknown app, choose "More details", then "Install anyway".
Open FreelanceCRM from your app screen and sign in to your account.
mobileApp.whatText: It is the same website in its own window, with no separate database. All data is kept in your account, so your clients are the same on the phone and on the computer. Website updates appear on their own, you do not need to reinstall the file.
mobileApp.warnText: The app is not published on Google Play yet, so the system shows a general warning for all files from other sources. Install it only from this page.
mobileApp.otherText: On iPhone, open the site in Safari, tap Share and choose "Add to Home Screen". On a computer in Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar.

about.title: About the project
about.lead: FreelanceCRM is a small CRM for freelancers: clients, notes, calculators and document templates in one place.

sections.heading: Why it exists
paragraphs: Freelancers rarely need a large system with dozens of settings. They need to know who the client is, what was agreed, how much the work costs and which documents to send. FreelanceCRM puts this into a simple interface that works on a phone and on a computer.

sections.heading: What is already there
items: Clients with an archive, restore and a notes diary.
Calculators for project cost and hourly rate.
Document templates.
Four languages: Ukrainian, English, Polish, Czech.
Installation on a phone as an app (PWA and Android).

sections.heading: How it works
paragraphs: Registration is free. The administrator reviews each new request. After approval a free trial starts, then access works by subscription. Payment is manual: the administrator sends an invoice and opens access until the agreed date. Details are on the Subscription page.

sections.heading: Who is behind it
paragraphs: The project is built and maintained by one independent developer. It grows step by step, so some things may change and some are not there yet: for example, issuing invoices inside the system and project tracking are not implemented.

sections.heading: Openness
paragraphs: The source code can be viewed in the project repository on GitHub. It is protected by copyright, see the LICENSE file for the terms.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: These terms govern the use of the FreelanceCRM website. By registering and using the service you agree to them.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: FreelanceCRM is an online service for managing clients, notes, calculations and document templates. Some tools are open without registration, while client management requires an account.

sections.heading: Account
items: Provide a real email address you can access and confirm it with the code sent to you.
You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for actions under your account.
One account is meant for one person.
The service is intended for adults.

sections.heading: Approval and access
paragraphs: The administrator reviews each new request. They may approve it, decline it or close access if these terms are broken. After approval a free trial applies, its length is shown on the Subscription page.

sections.heading: Subscription and payment
items: Paid access is open until the "paid until" date.
Payment is manual: on your request the administrator sends an invoice and opens access after payment.
The current price is shown on the Subscription page. There is no automatic charging and the subscription does not renew by itself.
Refund terms, if you need them, are agreed with the administrator before payment.
When access ends, sign-in to client management is closed, but your data is not deleted.

sections.heading: Your data
items: The client data and notes you enter belong to you. You allow the service to store and process them only to run the service.
You are responsible for having the lawful right to enter this data, including personal data of your clients, and for using it in accordance with the law.
You can archive and permanently delete clients and ask for your account to be deleted.
More details: the Privacy and cookies page.

sections.heading: Rules of use
paragraphs: You must not break the law, access other people's data or accounts, overload the service, or copy or distribute the service, its code and design without permission. Report vulnerabilities privately, as described in the project's security policy.

sections.heading: Calculators and templates
paragraphs: Calculator results and document template texts are for reference only. They are not legal, tax or financial advice. Check a template before using it and adapt it to your situation and the laws of your country.

sections.heading: Availability and changes
paragraphs: The service grows step by step and is provided "as is". We do not guarantee uninterrupted operation, outages are possible and features may change. Keep your own copies of important data.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, the service owner is not liable for indirect damage, lost profit or lost data caused by using the service. These terms do not limit consumer rights that cannot be limited under the law of your country.

sections.heading: Ending use
paragraphs: You can stop using the service at any time. The administrator may suspend or close access for breaking these terms. On your request your account and related data are deleted, as described in the privacy policy.

sections.heading: Changes and governing law
paragraphs: The terms may be updated, and a new version applies from the moment it is published on this page. These terms are governed by the law of Ukraine, unless mandatory rules of the consumer's country of residence provide otherwise.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.lead: This page explains what data FreelanceCRM collects, why, who receives it and what rights you have.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for the data
paragraphs: The owner of FreelanceCRM decides why and how account data is processed. The data about your clients that you enter is processed by you on your own responsibility, and the service only stores it for you.

sections.heading: What data we collect
items: Account: name, email address and password. The password is stored only as a protected hash in Neon Auth and we cannot see it.
Request and subscription status: approved or not, access end date, whether an invoice was requested.
Data you enter: clients, notes and their dates.
Technical data: IP address, browser type and request logs kept by the hosting provider for security and operation.
Preferences: language and theme.
Google Analytics visit statistics, only if you gave consent.

sections.heading: Why and on what basis
items: To create your account and provide the service: performance of a contract (terms of use).
To send the email verification code: performance of a contract.
To protect the service from abuse and errors: legitimate interest.
To understand how the site is used and improve it: your consent (Google Analytics). Without consent analytics is not enabled.

sections.heading: Who receives the data
paragraphs: Data is processed by providers the service cannot work without: Neon (database and authentication; the database is located in the EU, in Frankfurt), Vercel (website hosting) and, only with your consent, Google (analytics). Some of them may process data outside the EU and Ukraine, see their privacy policies for details. We do not sell your data and do not pass it to advertisers.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Account data and your records are kept while you use the service. Archived clients stay until you delete them permanently. On your request we delete your account and related data. Providers' backups may exist for a limited time longer.

sections.heading: Your rights
items: To learn what data we hold about you and get a copy.
To correct inaccurate data.
To delete data or restrict its processing.
To object to processing and to receive your data in a convenient format.
To withdraw consent to analytics at any time: use the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of the page.
To complain to a data protection authority: in Ukraine, the Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights; in EU countries, the authority of your country.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The service is not intended for people under 18. We do not knowingly collect their data.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this page. The date of the latest version is shown at the top.
